FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id IN

SELECT AVG(cpu_per) AS "cpuAvg", MAX(cpu_per) AS "cpuMax", (SELECT tm FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND tm BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ORDER BY cpu_per DESC LIMIT 1) AS "cpuMaxTim", AVG(mem_us)/1024.0/1024/1024 AS "redisMemAvg", MAX(mem_us)/1024.0/1024/1024 AS "redisMemMax", (SELECT tm FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND tm BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ORDER BY mem_us DESC LIMIT 1) AS "redisMemMaxTim", AVG(ops) AS "qpsAvg", MAX(ops) AS "qpsMax", (SELECT tm FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND tm BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ORDER BY ops DESC LIMIT 1) AS "qpsMaxTim", AVG(latency) AS "latencyAvg", MAX(latency) AS "latencyMax", (SELECT tm FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND tm BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ORDER BY latency DESC LIMIT 1) AS "latencyMaxTim", COUNT(*) AS "collectCount" FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND tm BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}

AS "bucket", AVG(cpu_per) AS "cpuUsage", AVG(mem_us)/1024.0/1024/1024 AS "redisMemUsed", AVG(ops) AS "qps", AVG(latency) AS "avgLatency" FROM rms_metric_log WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} AND tm BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
